feature_descriptions.self-sufficiency: At 8th level, the warden's protective discipline improves so the warden can maintain the patrol without depending on another creature's aid.

resources.name: Guarded Allies
resources.description: Record currently guarded allies. Establish a guard as a standard action, or as a swift action by spending 1 spell point.

resources.name: Guard AC Bonus
resources.description: AC bonus granted to every guarded ally: +1 at level 2, increasing at levels 6, 10, 14, and 18.

resources.name: Reinforcement DC
resources.description: 10 + half Warden level + casting ability modifier.

resources.name: Additional Attacks of Opportunity
resources.description: One additional attack of opportunity each round, plus another for every five Warden levels.

resources.name: Projected Empathy Distance
resources.description: Feet closer a visible guarded ally counts for the range of the Warden’s sphere effects; level 20 counts as adjacent.

resources.name: Indomitable Applies
resources.description: Enable for saves against mind-affecting effects; the permanent +2 CMD is handled separately.

choice_providers.label: Casting and Practitioner Ability
choice_providers.description: Choose the mental ability supplied by the Warden's unified tradition.

choice_providers.label: Vigil
choice_providers.description: Choose one permanent Vigil. It grants its associated sphere and its abilities at levels 3, 7, 11, 15, and 19.

choice_providers.label: Reinforcements
choice_providers.description: Choose one qualifying universal or vigil-specific Reinforcement at every even Warden level.

notes: High blended progression includes one choice per level; Guardian and the Vigil sphere are separate bonus spheres. Guard targets and scaling remain generic live resources.
